Delete multiple objects by their IDs.



You can provide IDs either:

- Via --ids flag (comma-separated): --ids BLI-001,BLI-002,BLI-003

- Via --file flag (YAML array of IDs): --file ids.yaml



By default, deletion will fail if any object has dependents.

Fail-closed: bare bulk delete is refused — pass --unlink-references or
--cascade (TRACK: BLI-REDACTED).

Use --unlink-references to remove each ID from dependents' reference fields
before deleting (matches single-object delete).

Use --cascade to delete objects and all their dependents recursively.

Do not combine --unlink-references with --cascade.

Core kernel kinds refuse hard delete unless --reason-code is set; prefer archive
+ aggregate/compress with lineage.



Optional --fields restricts each successful delete result row to those top-level
keys when present.

  Delete refused without unlink/cascade
  zqk object bulk delete --ids BLI-001,BLI-002,BLI-003
  Unlink references from dependents then delete
  zqk object bulk delete --ids CRIT-001,CRIT-002 --unlink-references
  Delete with cascade
  zqk object bulk delete --ids BLI-001,BLI-002 --cascade
  Delete from file
  zqk object bulk delete --file ids.yaml --unlink-references
  Dry-run to see what would be deleted
  zqk object bulk delete --ids BLI-001,BLI-002 --cascade --dry-run
  Break-glass core kind delete
  zqk object bulk delete --ids WS-010 --unlink-references --reason-code "duplicate fixture WS after migration audit 2026-08-03"

Usage:
  zqk object bulk delete [flags]

Flags:
      --cascade                 Delete object and all objects that reference it
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --dry-run                 Show what would be done without actually doing it
      --fields stringArray      Top-level keys for each successful delete entry in formatted output (when stored).
      --file string             Path to YAML file containing array of IDs
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ids string              Comma-separated list of object IDs
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --reason-code string      Required for hard-delete of core kernel kinds (min 30 chars); prefer archive+aggregate instead
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
      --unlink-references       Strip this ID from dependents' reference fields, then delete (does not delete dependent objects)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
